newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - April 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - April 7.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Monday:
WASHINGTON - Washington Redskins owner Jack Kent Cooke died after suffering a heart attack at his home. He was 84.
WASHINGTON - Jack Kent Cooke was a high school dropout who began his business career by selling encyclopedias door-to-door during the Great Depression of the 1930s.

CAPE CANAVERAL, FLORIDA - The potential for an explosion in an electrical generator forced astronauts aboard the Columbia shuttle flight to cut short their mission and prepare for a quick flight home.

WASHINGTON - Attorney General Janet Reno is deferring to career staff in determining whether to recommend an independent counsel investigate questionable campaign contributions to the Democratic Party.
TOKYO - Japan's ultranationalists are making themselves heard loud rallies and demonstrations.
